description: Changes a design and returns the complete changed design, validated against the rules and the limits of anonymous use. changes takes brief fields (an absent field keeps the design: width, rotation, model_width, exaggeration, relief, frame, colors, label, tiles, shape, or place or lat and lon to move the centre of tile 0); patch takes JSON Patch operations for every other field, applied after changes. The service stores no design: send the complete design every time and continue with the returned one.

changes.description: Brief fields to change. tiles arranges a new compact layout, label replaces the text of the first edge label or adds one, colors without template keeps the other colours.

colors.description: Colours: a template, or an object with an optional template and colours RRGGBB by group (ground: terrain, paved areas, sand and rock; green: vegetation, agriculture; water: water areas, sea, waterways; traffic: roads, paths, railways), by layer kind (terrain, paved_areas, bare_ground, vegetation, agriculture, water_areas, sea, waterways, major_roads, local_roads, paths, railways, buildings), frame, or label. Groups apply before layer kinds; every distinct colour is one filament.

label.description: Edge label text on the first tile, up to 64 characters.

model_width.description: Printed width of one tile in mm, 50 to 300; default 200.

place.description: Place or address; with lat and lon it only names the place.

relief.description: true prints real relief, false prints flat; default automatic.

tiles.description: Tile count, arranged compactly; at most 3 for agents.

width.description: Map width in metres, 100 to 30000; default 1500.

design.description: Complete design (MapRequest) as create_design returns it; the full JSON schema is the resource neuronform://schema/design and get_design_guide explains every section.

lang.description: Language of the summaries and error messages; default en.

patch.description: JSON Patch operations (RFC 6902 add, replace, remove) on the design JSON, applied after changes, such as {"op": "replace", "path": "/terrain/vertical_exaggeration", "value": 2.5} or {"op": "add", "path": "/customizations/decorations/-", "value": {...}}.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the design; - as last token appends to an array.

value.description: New value of add and replace.

name: edit_design
title: Edit design
